scope: Read-only sending-account/domain/config check and local dry-run only. No email send, key creation/rotation, contacts API, customer objects or sender source changes.

resend_domains.method: GET https://api.resend.com/domains; persist project domain configuration only, no domain IDs or DNS record values.

billing_worker.method: Cloudflare GET Worker secrets inventory; names only; no secret values returned or retrieved.

missing_campaign_inputs: Recipients with actual matching opt-in source/date/purpose; public contact details alone are not consent.
Current mailbox checks and reconciled unsubscribe/bounce/complaint suppressions.
An explicit campaign/message/batch instruction and tested opt-out URL.
limitations: Domain and secret existence prove configuration, not successful email acceptance or inbox delivery.
Read-only domain permission does not establish the exact local API-key scope; no key-management or send operation was attempted.
The 18 manual research targets are not an eligible subscriber campaign.

provider_policy.summary: Explicit opt-in required; unsolicited cold outreach and purchased/scraped contact lists prohibited.
